reason: Entries: only .row/JSR from sky_col_check's own top, reached only by JMP sky_col_check from sky_put_on's lead_col (sky.6502:296); .byte/.chk2_done are local, no outside refs (sky_edges calls sky_col_row only, unchanged). Reads: LDA at Y then ORA at Y-1.. down to stop+1, the same addresses as the original's clean row (rn=0 case: both do 256 reads); extra reads after a non-zero byte are screen reads with no side effects. Exits: C identical (dirty iff some byte of some unskipped row is non-zero; dirty now taken after the row instead of at the byte, X same row). V untouched by ORA/TAY, same as before; D unchanged; stack unchanged. Differences only in A (OR vs first non-zero byte / 0), Y (=A instead of the byte index / stop) and N: callers after lead_col do BCS fall (LDX sky_s; LDA sky_on,X; sky_erase_old -> sky_old_geom -> sky_geom TAY; or out: CLC RTS to put_on, whose .masked does LDX back / LDY dm_index) or LDA sky_c then lead_l/lead_r/draw (sky_image sets Y by TAY before any read; lead_col again rewrites all). So A, Y, N, Z dead after. Interrupt: irq1_handler writes no screen bytes or s_ptr/sky_stop; the new code writes nothing. Cycles: per row of n>=2 bytes 13n+2 vs 15n-1 (saves 2n-3), n=1 17 vs 14 (+3); from the window's counts (~14.1 bytes, ~2.4 rows entering the loop a pass, 2.3 calls) about 21 cycles a pass, ~9.1 a call, matching the claim's 9.4 within the n=1 uncertainty. Branches all stay in page &DF (BEQ DF58->DF61, BNE byte DF5F->DF5A, BNE dirty DF62->DF6B). Bytes: +8 (9 -> 17).
